subject: Trading
title: High-Frequency Trading
description: A quick win: understand High-Frequency Trading.

hook.text: Some trades happen in nanoseconds—faster than light travels one foot. Welcome to high-frequency trading.

buildup.text: HFT firms use algorithms and co-located servers to trade thousandths of a second ahead of everyone else.

discovery.text: They exploit tiny price differences across exchanges, profiting fractions of a cent millions of times.

twist.text: HFT adds liquidity but is controversial. Critics say it creates ghost liquidity that vanishes in crises.

climax.text: HFT now accounts for roughly half of all U.S. equity volume. The market runs on algorithms.

punchline.text: Machines trade faster than you can blink.

quiz.question: What is the main criticism of high-frequency trading?
options: It creates liquidity that can vanish during market stress
